title: chore: turn off grafana live in observability
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Set GF_LIVE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=0 on the Grafana container. In Grafana 11.4, this disables the frontend’s Live connection, so open dashboard tabs no longer hold a WebSocket that prevents the container from reaching its 10-minute sleep timer; the frontend also avoids connection retries and “connection lost” banners. Provisioned dashboards do not use Live or streaming: their ClickHouse stat, table, timeseries, and text panels refresh hourly. The observability README now explains the setting and removes WebSocket from the rollout checklist.
